introduction: This level targets the 'Engineering Wonders' of ancient India, such as rock-cut temples, and the monuments of the powerful Vijayanagara Empire.

core_concepts.title: Kailasanatha Temple (Ellora)
core_concepts.description:
Location: Ellora Caves, **Maharashtra**. 
Builder: Rashtrakuta King **Krishna I**. 
Key Feature: The world’s largest **Monolithic** structure (carved from a single rock top-down). It is dedicated to Lord Shiva.

core_concepts.title: Shore Temple & Rathas of Mahabalipuram
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Tamil Nadu**. 
Builder: Pallava King **Narasimhavarman I** (Mamalla). 
Key Feature: Includes the 'Pancha Rathas' (Five Chariots), each carved from a single piece of granite. The Shore Temple is one of the oldest structural stone temples in South India.

core_concepts.title: Monuments at Hampi
core_concepts.description:
Location: **Karnataka** (Banks of Tungabhadra River). 
Builder: Vijayanagara Empire (mostly King **Krishnadevaraya**). 
Key Feature: Famous for the **Virupaksha Temple** and the **Stone Chariot**. 
Currency: The Hampi Stone Chariot is featured on the **₹50 note**.

core_concepts.title: Lingaraj Temple
core_concepts.description:
Location: Bhubaneswar, **Odisha**. 
Builder: Somavamsi Dynasty. 
Key Feature: The largest temple in Bhubaneswar (Kalinga Architecture), representing the 'Hari-Hara' form (Shiva and Vishnu together).

important_entities.name: Monolithic Architecture
important_entities.significance: Monolithic means 'One Stone'. Temples like the Kailasanatha and the Rathas of Mahabalipuram were not built with bricks; they were 'sculpted' out of existing mountain faces.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
The Hardest Exam Trap: There are two famous 'Kailasanatha' temples: 
1. Kailasanatha at **Kanchipuram**: Built by Pallavas. 
2. Kailasanatha at **Ellora**: Built by Rashtrakutas (This one is the monolithic wonder).

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Kailasa at Ellora is a Gift from Krishna
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: The Ellora Kailasanatha temple was built by King Krishna I of the Rashtrakuta Dynasty.

exam_strategy_tips: A common NDA/CDS and SSC CGL Tier-2 question: 'Which Pallava ruler built the monolithic rathas at Mahabalipuram?' Answer: Narasimhavarman I.
